description: This file defines the main React component 'MindmapClient' for an interactive mind map application. It manages state, fetches data from API endpoints, handles user interactions like zoom/pan and node selection, and renders subcomponents such as filters, canvas, and details panels.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to constrain a number between min and max.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns default filter settings for the mind map filters.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Returns default view state for the mind map, including position, zoom, filters, and selection.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Sanitizes and merges input object into a valid MindmapViewState.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a stable user identifier, using personaId if available, or creating a random anonymous ID stored in localStorage.

methods.name: MindmapClient
methods.description: Main React component managing the interactive mind map UI, state, data fetching, and rendering.
